summary: The feature work is done, and it matches every decision agreed with the product owner. That covers 8 ports with pins that round-trip through the text, and automatic ends that pick the nearest dot. Mind maps can be dragged, with per-node colour, ↺ Auto layout and branch-colour inheritance. The ```sequence kind has participants, messages, replies, self-messages, notes and step numbers, and no frames. SVG/PNG download has a white background, a 2× PNG, the '<chapter>-<kind>-<n>' file name, ScuLaFolder.save, and buttons both in the modal and on the preview. sketch.js reuses the diagram chrome, with ✎ on any preview picture and one undo step. No dependency was added. Every finding from the last round was addressed in code: the Escape/Ctrl+Z capture forwarding, the dgDlFailed toast, the removal of debug.tmp.js, and the tests/diagram.js expectation. The old expectation was stale, not a behaviour change, because the parser's tab handling is untouched on this branch. I ran the suites myself this round. `node tests/diagram.js` (the /apptest diagram gate) passes all its checks. tests/mdundo.js and tests/codecopy.js pass, and sketch.js passes `node --check`. The root `npm test` passes 151 of 152. It is still not mergeable. The one failing test is the new regression check for the Escape fix, and it fails because of how the test is written, so the suite is red. The branch has still not been synced with main, which edits four of the same files, so /verify has never been run on what would actually merge. A second stray npm-init package.json is committed in the task folder, and the test report is a placeholder.
findings: RED SUITE (test defect, not an app bug): tests/01-for-index-html-page-please-add/exclusive.spec.js:67 times out on `page.click('#diagram-modal .dg-spacer')`. Playwright reports the element as 'not visible': the bar is full at 1280 px, so the empty `.dg-spacer` (index.html:3980, `flex: 1`) has zero size. The behaviour itself works, because exclusive.spec.js:57-58 already shows that Escape from focus outside the modal closes it. Fix the test and not the app. Click a non-focusable part of the bar that does have size, for example `page.click('#dg-title')` for the diagram modal and `page.click('#sk-title')` for the sketch modal. Keep the existing assertion that focus left the modal. Re-run until `npm test` from the repo root reports 152 passed.

SYNC WITH MAIN (carried over from the last review, still not done): the merge base is still 1c0af6f. Since then main has added 5 commits (song.html, js/audio/*, tests/verify.js, and the shared nav edited in all eight pages). Main also changes index.html, CLAUDE.md, docs/FEATURES.md and docs/MAP.md, which this branch changes too. Merge main into this branch without switching branches (`git merge main`), and resolve those four files. Keep the nav block exactly as main has it, since this branch does not touch it. Then run `/verify` (parse check, nav byte-identity across all eight, diacritics) and `node tests/diagram.js` again on the merged tree, and paste both outputs into the implementation report.

HOUSEKEEPING: docs/tasks/01-for-index-html-page-please-add/package.json is a default `npm init` file with `"test": "echo \"Error: no test specified\" && exit 1"`. It is not part of the pipeline, and it makes `npm test` fail when run from that folder, which is what happened to me. Remove it with `git rm`.

REPORTS: test-report.json still says 'BLOCKED, NOT VERIFIED'. After the two fixes above, re-run `npm test` at the repo root, `node tests/diagram.js`, and the neighbour suites for the index.html files this branch touched (codecopy, mdundo, timeline, cause). Record the real counts in test-report.json with status 'pass', and give the passing exclusive.spec.js cases by name.
